fusions.name: Shale Jaws
fusions.desc: A bite of jagged rock that deals 9 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Silt Frenzy
fusions.desc: Rips into a wounded target for 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to the blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and that threshold rises with each rank.

fusions.name: Churned Shallows
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 12 seconds and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour also rises by 6%.
